item.title: Natchitoches selected for second phase grant to boost economic growth, resilience
item.description: The City of Natchitoches announced it was selected by the National League of Cities (NLC) to move forward to the Implementation Phase of the Southern Cities Economic Initiative (SCEI). item.title: Weekly weather outlook: mild midweek, rain chances increase by the weekend
item.description: Natchitoches Parish residents can expect a mostly mild and unsettled week ahead, with warm daytime temperatures through the end of the workweek before widespread rain and storms arrive over the weekend. Wednesday will be mostly cloudy with a slight chance of showers, around 20 percent. item.title: Village of Natchez to hold special called meeting on February 12 to discuss grant
item.description: The Village of Natchez Council called a special called meeting on Thursday, Feb. 12 at 6PM. The meeting will be held at the Town Hall, located at 219 Main Street in Natchez. The purpose of the meeting is to discuss a grant which deadline is to apply by Feb. 24, 2026.

item.title: School board approves Echo Ride transportation contract after lengthy debate
item.description: The Natchitoches Parish School Board approved a new student transportation contract at its Feb. 10 following an extended discussion centered on cost, service reliability, employee concerns, and long-term district stability. item.title: Patsy Ward Hoover qualifies for re-election as Mayor of the Village of Natchez
item.description: Patsy Johnson Ward Hoover officially qualified Wednesday, Feb. 11, for the upcoming election for Mayor of the Village of Natchez. Hoover, who has served as mayor since July 1, 2022, is seeking re-election, citing more than five decades of public service and community leadership in Natchez and Natchitoches Parish. item.title: UPDATE: Krewe of Dionysos parade, pet parade rescheduled to Sunday
item.description: Due to expected bad weather, both parades have been rescheduled to Sunday, February 15. The Krewe of Waguns parade will now roll at 3:00 p.m. The Krewe of Dionysos parade will follow at 6:00 p.m. Organizers encourage everyone to plan accordingly and look forward to a great (and hopefully drier) celebration on Sunday.
